## 問題
黑貓宅急便 2025 年第一季的準時送達率是多少？

## 回答 A
最終答案: 無法計算
採用的定義與依據: 黑貓 2025 年第一季共出貨 4979 筆、已送達 4451 筆，但 shipments 表沒有預計送達時間或承諾時效欄位，語意層也沒有「準時送達」的定義（兩次搜尋皆無結果），無法判定哪些包裹準時。需要公司提供準時標準（例如承諾天數或預計送達欄位）才能計算。
SQL 1: SELECT carrier, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(shipped_ts) AS min_shipped, MAX(delivered_ts) AS max_delivered, SUM(CASE WHEN delivered_ts IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_delivered FROM shipments GROUP BY carrier
  結果: {'columns': ['carrier', 'n', 'min_shipped', 'max_delivered', 'null_delivered'], 'rows': [['blackcat', 19911, '2024-12-31 05:07:42', '2026-01-08 09:31:43', 2134], ['hct', 11092, '2024-12-31 10:14:46', '2026-01-08 23:29:30', 1233], ['post', 6635, '2024-12-31 04:11:32', '2026-01-10 06:08:37', 768], ['s
SQL 2: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_shipped, SUM(CASE WHEN delivered_ts IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_delivered, MIN(shipped_ts) AS min_shipped, MAX(shipped_ts) AS max_shipped FROM shipments WHERE carrier = 'blackcat' AND shipped_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND shipped_ts < '2025-04-01'
  結果: {'columns': ['n_shipped', 'n_delivered', 'min_shipped', 'max_shipped'], 'rows': [[4979, 4451, '2025-01-01 01:07:59', '2025-03-31 23:57:03']], 'truncated': False}

## 回答 B
最終答案: 無法計算
採用的定義與依據: shipments 只有 shipped_ts 與 delivered_ts，沒有承諾送達日或 SLA 欄位；語意層搜尋「準時」「送達」「SLA」「配送時效」皆無對應定義。承運商代碼為 blackcat（黑貓），可對應到 shipments.carrier，但準時的判定標準缺失，需由業務方提供承諾時效後才能計算。
SQL 1: SELECT carrier, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(shipped_ts) AS min_shipped, MAX(delivered_ts) AS max_delivered, SUM(CASE WHEN delivered_ts IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_delivered FROM shipments GROUP BY carrier
  結果: {'columns': ['carrier', 'n', 'min_shipped', 'max_delivered', 'null_delivered'], 'rows': [['blackcat', 19911, '2024-12-31 05:07:42', '2026-01-08 09:31:43', 2134], ['hct', 11092, '2024-12-31 10:14:46', '2026-01-08 23:29:30', 1233], ['post', 6635, '2024-12-31 04:11:32', '2026-01-10 06:08:37', 768], ['s

response: ᅠ{"winner": "A", "reason": "兩者皆正確指出缺乏準時標準而無法計算，但 A 額外查出黑貓 2025Q1 出貨 4979 筆、已送達 4451 筆的可驗證背景數據，B 只做了全表承運商概覽，未聚焦問題期間。", "critical_error": false}
